caseno: Civil Petition For Leave To Appeal No. 1653 of 2010
lawyer:
Mr. Goutam Kumar Roy, Deputy Attorney General instructed by Mahmuda Begum, Advocate-on-Record ------ For the Petitioners.
Respondents ------ Not represented.
parties:
Government of Bangladesh and others
Vs.
Abdul Karim Bhuiyan and others
full_judgment: 6. On careful consideration of the evidence on record including the Advocate Commissioner's report, the proceeding under Waqf Act in respect of the waqf land the High Court Division calm to the conclusion that though .39 acre of land of the suit plot has been recorded in the name of government in khatian only, but there is nothing to prove that this land vested in the government by operation of the State Acquisition and Tenancy Act. The High Court Division pointed out also that since in C.S. and also in S.A. khatian the suit land has been recorded in the name of the predecessors of the plaintiffs and since there is nothing to prove that there is an established old hat or bazar in the suit land the R.S. khatian only could not prove at all that there is actually any old hat and bazar in the suit land and as such it vested in the government according to the provision of the State Acquisition and Tenancy Act.
